**Lane:** L1-CLIMATE · **Wave:** W2 · **Story:** S1-QUIET · **Gate:** jason-ota

### What
Add a min-on/min-off dwell floor and a per-relay max-cycles/hr governor to the three climate misters (center/south/west), which today bypass the dwell-protected R[] array entirely.

### Why
Verified: the misters are NOT in the RelayMeta R[] array (controls.yaml:92-99 — only heat1/heat2/fan1/fan2/fog/vent are); the mister relays are toggled directly by the pulse-timer FSM (controls.yaml:1336-1338) with only a per-zone VPD hysteresis floor (mister_hysteresis_kpa) and no min-on/min-off. Result (lead evidence): mister_center 505 on-events/7d, 202 sub-60s, 79 sub-30s incl 0s pulses, 191 refires <90s; mister_south 220/80/28; vs vent/fan/heat 0-1 sub-60s because their dwell works. This is the REAL chatter the PR #385 observability does not fix. A 120s/60s dwell + VPD hysteresis floor collapses a sub-120s pulse-train into one held pulse, ~40-55% fewer mister on-events with moisture delivery preserved.

### How
Add new ESPHome globals mister_min_on_s (default 120) and mister_min_off_s (default 60) in globals.yaml + number entities in tunables.yaml + cfg_mister_min_on_s / cfg_mister_min_off_s readbacks in sensors.yaml (CI no-new-fire-and-forget). Wire the dwell through the mister FSM turn-on path (controls.yaml ~1336-1338 center_mister/south_wall_mister/west_wall_mister .turn_on) and the pulse/gap timer (PULSE_ON_MS/PULSE_GAP_MS at ~1228) and the BLOCKED off path (~1186-1200) — NOT the RelayMeta R[] climate-relay array. Add per-zone last_on/last_off stamps and a rolling on-edge counter for a max-cycles/hr clamp. Add invariant in firmware/test/invariants.h (TraceRow already carries eq_mister_south/west/center per invariant #2/#6) asserting no mister on-edge within mister_min_off_s and no off within mister_min_on_s, and on-edges/hr per relay under the governor. Add unit tests in test_greenhouse_logic.cpp replaying a sub-120s pulse-train.

### Acceptance
- [ ] No mister exceeds its max-cycles/hr over the replay corpus (new invariant); make firmware-invariants green
- [ ] Mister min-on/min-off enforced — new unit test in test_greenhouse_logic.cpp + make test-firmware green
- [ ] cfg_mister_min_on_s / cfg_mister_min_off_s readbacks present (no-new-fire-and-forget CI green)
- [ ] make firmware-replay OLD=<base> NEW=HEAD divergence is the documented intended dwell-collapse only (THRESHOLD_PCT override + coordinator note per freeze rule 8)
- [ ] make firmware-check compiles

### Dependencies
#377, #300

**Lane:** L1-CLIMATE · **Wave:** W3 · **Story:** S2-DEHUM · **Gate:** jason-ota

### What
Re-scope the hardcoded-active overnight closed-vent heat_dehum path (greenhouse_logic.h:1580) as opt-in behind a new tunable defaulting OFF with a cfg_* readback, add a fog/mister anti-ping-pong post-wet hold, and ship as a separate OTA after the #377 float trial is observed clean, with a before/after overnight-heat1 outcome check.

### Why
Verified: closed_heat_dehum_wanted (greenhouse_logic.h:1447) is hardcoded-active with no enable gate; the override fires at line 1580 whenever the 11-condition night/edge/estimator gate holds. The lead's adversarial check confirms it is technically ADR-0004-compliant (edge-acting: fires only when in.vpd_kpa < served vpd_low - HV, night, temp-in-band, heat1-only, vent closed, estimator-proven, heat1 has a 180s min-off rail) — BUT bundling it with the float-flip CONFOUNDS the float trial and adds overnight IDLE->heat1 runtime in the exact wet-night regime the sprint is quieting (orchid overnight RH 84% regression is the plant value at stake). Replay: 50 rows / 0.03%, all IDLE-mode + heat1-only, all March cold-spring nights (DORMANT in summer). Also: fog/mister self-induces wet corrections that ping-pong with dehum (fog 87 of 471 re-ons within 90s).

### How
Add ESPHome global closed_heat_dehum_enabled (bool default false) + entity in tunables.yaml + cfg_closed_heat_dehum_enabled readback in sensors.yaml. Gate the override block (greenhouse_logic.h:1580 and the closed_heat_dehum_wanted predicate at 1447) on the new flag. Add a post-wet anti-ping-pong hold: after a fog/mister burst ends, suppress the immediate vent/dehum response for a short settle so VPD stabilizes before the next correction, and symmetrically block re-fog within ~90s (settle ONE mechanism per BC-8). Ship as a SEPARATE OTA AFTER #377 is read clean; gate the enable=true decision on an outcome_kpi/replay before/after overnight-heat1 on-events check. Requires #327 moisture telemetry live (climate_moisture_exchange currently returns 0 rows in prod — the moisture KPI is inert pre-deploy).

### Acceptance
- [ ] closed_heat_dehum_enabled defaults false; cfg_closed_heat_dehum_enabled readback present (no-new-fire-and-forget green)
- [ ] make firmware-replay OLD=<base> shows the heat1-only divergence is gated to zero when the flag is OFF (default), and the documented heat1-only rows only when ON
- [ ] Before/after overnight heat1 on-events report from #371 KPI surface (requires #327 moisture telemetry live)
- [ ] Unit tests cover overnight low-wet idle, fog/dehum anti-ping-pong, and the enable-gate OFF/ON branches (make test-firmware)
- [ ] make firmware-invariants + make firmware-check green; OTA Jason-gated, separate from the #299/grow-light window

### Dependencies
#377, #327, #371, #293
